text: {"label":"Social Behavior, Cooperation, and Altruism","definition":"Experimental and applied analysis of social behavior: cooperation, sharing, altruism, group and interpersonal contingencies, intergroup aggression, and the reinforcing value of social interaction, including assessments of social functions and social time allocation.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Concerns behavior between people and the contingencies controlling it, not creativity and complex behavior, stakeholder judgments of social validity, or disseminating behavior science through social media."}
